title: Slipping into something else
author: Kakoli Ghosh
text:
My breaths do not know your love for me,
digging through the walls of emptiness,
I place my eyes in the gliding distance,
the veins of darkness carve out
my route to the last wall.
Layers of my presence dry slowly
crumbling into the sundried flavors
of the passing months,
paddy fields dance ripened,
drowned in overwhelming monsoon.
Memories wait uprooted,
secrets smile at the sun,
upset nests find a way
out of this flooded freedom.
Hatching space,
forgotten clumsiness under hygiene,
a red ribbon bow ties up my womb
presenting the oldest town of ruins.
